notes: Access: direct fetch worked (no WAF). Site nav ('Home' mega-menu / sitemap page) mapped, then exact counts pulled from the site's own listing endpoint https://pb.goodearth.in/myapi/search/?category_shop=<path> which returns a top-level 'count' field that matches the rendered 'N products found' text on the PLP (cross-checked on Vases: both = 21). Excluded (out of scope, confirmed by title inspection): Home Textiles, Cushion Covers, Table Linen, Kids (incl. Kids Apparel, Kids Bed & Bath) - all textile/apparel; Bath & Fragrance > Aromatherapy/LilaNur Parfums/Bath & Bodycare/Towels and Ancient Rituals > Incense & Dhuna/Honey - fragrance/food consumables; Decor > Journals - stationery; Decor > Wallcoverings (38 items) - wallpaper, explicit exclusion; Decor > Umbrellas (3 items, confirmed via product dump to be literal rain umbrellas, not decor); Apparel (Sustain Woman); the Gifting section (Shop By Occasion/Recipient) - gift-guide roll-up over the same underlying products, not extracted per NEVER EXTRACT. Also excluded three named 'collection' roll-up pages that surfaced in the facet list ('Home > Jaipur Rose' 17, 'Home > Edit' 13, 'Home > Isla' 16) - each is a cross-category capsule/collection mixing Dinnerware+Serveware+Textile+Candle items already counted under their real subcategories; treated as brand/collection listing pages per NEVER EXTRACT, not counted separately to avoid double-counting. Three genuinely mixed in-scope/out-of-scope categories were split by manual title-by-title inspection of the FULL result set (page_size >= category count, so every title was seen, not a sample): (1) 'Candles & Stands' (18 total) = 7 candle stands/bases with no wax (Mandala Base S/L, Persia Candle Base, Tamara Candle Base, Tamara Candle Stand, Palmyra Candle Stand, Lotus Candle Stand) kept as decorative candle holders + 11 scented candles (Al-Andalus, Botanica x2, Jaipur Rose Chand, Samarqand x2, White Gardenia, Sarovar, Geodesis x3) dropped as Home Fragrance. (2) 'Barware' (8 total) = 3 pure serving vessels (Alexandria Wine Cooler, Argent Aperitif Jug, Mandalay Cocktail Tray) kept + 5 dropped for bundling an excluded bar tool/cutlery component (Forest Stirrers; 2x Cheese Board With Knife; 2x Ice Bowl/Bucket & Tong). (3) 'Bathroom Accessories' (15 total) = 13 decorative ceramic accessory pieces (tissue boxes, soap dish/dispenser/cotton holder, tumbler, tray, jewel boxes) kept + 2 'Pebble Cotton Bath Mat' dropped as textile. Duplicate-company check: no other 'Good Earth' home-decor company appears elsewhere in this project's list to my knowledge; this is the well-known Indian luxury lifestyle brand goodearth.in, first appearance for S.N. 303.
